# KAYNA — Personal Development Clothing Brand

> KAYNA is a premium streetwear brand focused on personal development. The name means "certainty" in Songhaï language. Three core values: Confidence, Self-Improvement, Perseverance.

## About KAYNA
KAYNA is a premium streetwear clothing brand dedicated to personal development and self-improvement. Founded in 2024, KAYNA creates high-quality apparel (t-shirts, hoodies, sweaters) made from 240 GSM organic cotton with ethical production practices. The brand bridges African heritage with modern streetwear culture, empowering wearers through motivational design and messaging.

## Brand Identity
- **Name Origin**: "KAYNA" means "certainty" in Songhaï (West African language)
- **Slogan**: "La certitude inébranlable" (The unshakeable certainty)
- **Core Values**: Confidence (Confiance), Self-Improvement (Dépassement), Perseverance (Persévérance)
- **Target Audience**: People interested in personal development, self-growth, mental strength, and motivational fashion

## Products
- **T-Shirts**: Premium organic cotton, 240 GSM, unisex, motivational designs
- **Hoodies**: Heavy-weight streetwear hoodies, 240 GSM organic cotton, premium quality
- **Sweaters**: Elegant organic cotton sweaters with personal development messaging
- **Material**: 100% organic cotton, 240 GSM weight
- **Production**: Ethical and sustainable manufacturing
